raw_segments.text: A cloud began to cover the sun slowly, wholly, shadowing the bay in deeper green.
It lay beneath him a bowl of bitter waters.
I sang it alone in the house, holding down the long dark cords.
She wanted to hear my music.
Silent with awe and pity, I went to her bedside.
She was crying in her wretched bed.
For those words, Stephen, loves bitter mystery.
